outputs/teds/a_meta.json.completeness_rule: TEDS admissions in every year 2015-2023 and total admissions never change by more than 50% year to year (ratio within [0.5, 1.5])
outputs/teds/a_meta.json.method:
Admissions are not prevalence: they count treatment episodes at publicly funded facilities, depend on
funding, capacity and referral practice, and miss office-based buprenorphine. Never joined to NSDUH.
